findings: Both C consumer GPRs import the same root library project. The prebuilt scenario sets its Externally_Built attribute, leaving configuration/profile/link selection on the existing GPR paths.

Default pipeline builds root before linking C, CLI and nested tests with the prebuilt scenario. Instrumented pipeline builds the nested tests and their root dependency before linking C consumers with the same scenario.

Core-image check hashes the selected runtime image before linking, after building both consumer projects and after executing the consumers. Existing matrix replay still compares independently captured runtime names and hashes.

On 8196b80 both Linux instrumented contexts passed the oracle identity comparison. Each GC and IO C consumer and scoped C events report recorded libconformance_lua.so SHA256 38430b1f9b8084609494b667040999e39bb8b1c4ada886393296d7c346432d76.

Each runtime-producing command now explicitly selects LUA_ADA_PREBUILT=false. Default and instrumented owner builds and standalone core-image execution override inherited scenario values. Imported hosts select true for the subsequent link.
